newsitem.title: USA: MedImmune says MEDI-493 seen safe in tests.
newsitem.headline: MedImmune says MEDI-493 seen safe in tests.

text.p: MedImmune Inc said Thursday that Phase 1/2 clinical trials showed its MEDI-493 was generally safe and well tolerated by children.
MEDI-493 is a humanized monoclonal antibody being developed for use in combating serious RSV disease in children.
RSV is the most common cause of lower respiratory infections in infants and children worldwide.

MediImmune said the double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose- escalating, multi-center Phase 1/2 trial evaluating safety and pharmacological properties of MEDI-493 in children showed no significant differences in adverse events or immunogenicity observed between patients receiving placebo or MEDI-493. MedImmune said these results suggest MEDI-493 was generally safe and well-tolerated.

The Phase 1/2 trial was conducted at 10 medical centers in the United States. A total of 62 infants with a history of prematurity or a lung condition called bronchopulmonary dysplasia were randomized to receive a placebo or MEDI-493 at 3 mg/kg, 10 mg/kg or 15 mg/kg once per month intravenously for up to 5 doses. The primary objectives of this study were to
assess the safety, tolerance, immunogenicity and pharmacokinetics of MEDI-493 in these high-risk infants.
